fields.label: Description
fields.name: software_desc
fields.default_value: We are a 3D animation studio that creates hyper-realistic animated videos and walkthroughs using various programs. We are advanced users of Unreal Engine, particularly for character, object, environment, interior, and exterior animation. Static renders are created in Autodesk 3ds Max, a program we have been working with for over 7 years. For some special projects, we use Blender and Autodesk Maya. For creating realistic effects, our 3D artists prefer Houdini and Cinema 4D. Texturing and sculpting are done in ZBrush. We keep track of industry trends and always stay up to date with the latest software developments. Our team members have completed around 15 different training courses to master each program professionally. Their regular updates and continuous learning give us a competitive edge, allowing us to complete projects faster and with higher quality than others.
